title: Normal-user journeys with small samples; Android first, macOS on permission
context: The composer gate queue on macOS ran for hours on statistical counts (10,000 fuzz sequences, 20 clicks per hold per position) while the release gate had already failed on GP1, GP5 and a GR6 drag bug, so the extra counts could not change any decision. The owner asked for an efficient, practically thorough end-to-end test of the whole app, starting with Android, asking before macOS.
options: Re-run every 6.14 gate at full counts on both platforms
Normal-user journeys across all features with small bug-hunting samples
outcome: Fifteen user journeys per platform covering every feature, each timeboxed to about 20 minutes, one retry per flaky step, findings ranked Blocks, Hurts, Cosmetic. Full-count gate runs are deferred to the pre-merge gate after fixes, because any commit invalidates gate results anyway. Android runs first on the Galaxy Note 10+ from a clean restart; macOS starts only after the owner's explicit go-ahead.
